summary: Net.Core owns serializer-independent ITransport and typed message-channel seams, with sequential or multiplexed correlation. WebSocket transport and Protobuf codecs are separate adapters. GrpcTransport is a thin GrpcChannel lifecycle wrapper and does not implement ITransport. SC2 raw Protobuf uses an echoed-ID guard so mismatched replies fail rather than becoming stale results. Optional Elmish integration is independent of FS.GG.UI; product gateways retain domain authority. The repository owns transport and delivery primitives, while current runtime and native product acceptance remain separate.
title: Domain-neutral protobuf transports
